evidence_method: Selected terminal output transcribed from live Tango screenshots. Raw logs are retained on the phone, but have not been exported into this repository or independently hashed from retrieved bytes.

screenshot_artifact.scope: Retained terminal screenshot showing the stdin-only control summary, both vCPUs' selected guest results, native counters, QEMU exit and checker failure; not the complete raw logs.

evidence_qualification.hash_transcription_method: The phone displayed each SHA-256 as two 32-character halves using cut; the halves were transcribed and joined without depending on terminal folding.
evidence_qualification.earlier_controls: Qualitative observations only where complete commands, counts or logs were not supplied. Missing metrics are not reconstructed.

QEMU.identity: Original required-native executable; unchanged for the stdin-only control.

guest.scope: Existing synthetic EL1 setup and EL0 benchmark, not an iOS image.

uploaded_package.qualification: This is the v1 package actually used on the phone, not the separately corrected v2 checker package.

benchmark_configuration.native_architecture_qualification: This hybrid engine invokes native EL0 from QEMU's TCG loop; guest EL1 and unsupported paths continue under TCG. The accelerator argument alone does not imply TCG-only execution. Positive native SVC and execution counters are retained separately below.

earlier_controls.name: loader_controls
earlier_controls.qualification: The unchanged required-native executable passed loader checks. No additional unpreserved command list or metrics are asserted here.

earlier_controls.name: native_enabled_version_control
earlier_controls.qualification: Native-enabled initialization and version output do not qualify an active guest.

earlier_controls.name: initial_v1_run_with_inherited_stdin
earlier_controls.qualification: The bounded run ended with exit 137. That observation alone does not identify the blocking subsystem or prove that native execution is unavailable.

earlier_controls.name: paused_native_enabled_QMP_control
earlier_controls.qualification: The paused machine and QMP control completed; this does not establish EL0 payload progress.

earlier_controls.name: RLIMIT_FSIZE_control
earlier_controls.qualification: The coordinating session marked this file-size-limit control invalid. Its outcome is not used as a native-engine or stdin result.

earlier_controls.name: early-execution-2
earlier_controls.qualification: This earlier active run had positive native execution and the same T7 failures. Its unpreserved metrics are not substituted for the later stdin-only control.

stdin_only_control.change: Invoked the unchanged uploaded v1 runner with stdin redirected from /dev/null.
stdin_only_control.failure_reason: guest mismatch or native failure diagnostic

observed_timing_counters_ms.qualification: Native/trap/entry counters are aggregated engine measurements. They must not be added to or directly equated with wall time. No speedup, throughput or iOS-performance claim is derived from these counters or the wrapper's six-second elapsed report.

stdin_only_control.counter_qualification: The positive native entry, SVC and native-time counters together with completed guest output establish actual native execution. They do not prove that every EL0 instruction ran natively or that the benchmark passed. The failed-fill and injected-fault counts are preserved without independently classifying every exception.
stdin_only_control.stdin_interpretation: Redirecting stdin allowed this unchanged v1 runner to complete an active guest run in this control, while the earlier inherited-stdin attempt had no guest output. This supports using the explicit stdin redirection for subsequent isolated runs; it does not conclusively identify the earlier hang's internal root cause.

retained_phone_evidence.hash_qualification: These are the on-phone digests read from screenshots. Independent verification awaits retrieval of the complete corresponding bytes.

failure_interpretation.v1_checker_issue: The v1 checker independently had a guest CPU-prefix handling bug. A v2 checker corrected that issue separately.
failure_interpretation.checker_issue_qualification: The two observed T7 MISMATCH lines are a valid failure regardless of the CPU-prefix bug. Correcting the checker cannot turn this execution into a passing benchmark.
failure_interpretation.source_diagnosis: The generic native path reads the host's TPIDRRO_EL0 value, observed as zero here, instead of supplying the guest value expected by T7. This is a generic native TPIDRRO-handling issue; missing app flags are not the identified explanation.
failure_interpretation.source_diagnosis_qualification: This diagnosis comes from source review together with the repeated phone symptom. It is distinct from the still-unresolved internal cause of the earlier stdin-sensitive startup stall.
failure_interpretation.existing_iOS_mode: The existing iOS mode implements a different guest ABI and is not a generic fix for this benchmark.

generic_TPIDRRO_candidate.qualification: A separately built generic TPIDRRO candidate still requires its own phone result. The observed counters and failures above belong to the unchanged original executable.

supported_conclusion: The original required-native QEMU executes the synthetic guest's EL0 work natively on the Pixel under UID 0 with SELinux enforcing. With stdin redirected from /dev/null, the unchanged v1 runner completed and reported positive native counters, successful T6/T10 checks and guest EXIT 0 on both vCPUs. The benchmark correctly remains failed because both vCPUs report the T7 TPIDRRO mismatch.
not_established: A fully passing native-engine benchmark or correctness of the generic TPIDRRO candidate.
Native execution of every guest EL0 instruction or elimination of the engine's unsupported-instruction paths.
The conclusive internal root cause of the inherited-stdin no-output attempt.
Native QEMU execution under an ordinary Android app UID.
GPU producer-backed guest memory, integrated Metal/reims execution or the selected cached-data native bridge.
An iOS 26 boot, full-system correctness or performance.

continuity.remaining_evidence_action: Retrieve both complete shared-folder log copies, recompute their hashes against the transcribed digests, and reconcile this record with the raw output.
continuity.remaining_native_qualification: A separate phone run of the generic TPIDRRO candidate must pass the benchmark checks; neither an iOS-ABI switch nor suppression of the mismatch is a substitute.
